nodes.question: What is necessary for all stakeholders to accept and use natural materials?
nodes.answer: A better understanding of bio-based materials is necessary for all stakeholders to accept and use them.
nodes.paragraph: This research significantly influences the built environment and promotes net-zero targets within the sector. Keywords LCA Biogenic carbon Thermal conductivity Insulation materials Dynamic 1 Introduction There have been individual exemplar projects demonstrating that is possible to achieve environmental targets by using bio-based materials (Dams et al. 2023). However, environ- ment-friendly bio-based projects have not proliferated in the construction sector (Dams et al. 2023). Professionals scepticism, industrial upscaling and policy and regulation Communicated by Alexander Hollberg. * Valeria Cascione V.cascione@bath.ac.uk 1 Department of Architecture and Civil Engineering, University of Bath, Claverton Down, Bath BA2 7AY, UK 2 Institute for Sustainability, University of Bath, Claverton Down, Bath BA2 7AY, UK 602 The International Journal of Life Cycle Assessment (2025) 30:601 620 limitations create barriers to the use of bio-based materi- als. Dams et al. (2023) demonstrated that professionals are concerned about availability and knowledge of bio-based solutions. Moreover, insufficient incentives and construction related culture and habit are a significant barrier to the use of bio-based materials. A better understanding of bio-based materials is vital to enable all stakeholders to accept and use natural materials.
